content: bricomarche.pt is WordPress/WooCommerce; site requires choosing a store before search. WooCommerce Store API /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?search= returns JSON; products are 'variable' with attribute Loja (per-store variations). Example PLACA OSB 12 MM price_range 18.49-29.99 EUR across stores; top-level price is the minimum across stores. Description has dimension typo 2500x125x12 mm.
